total_funding_usd.basis: Sum of confirmed rounds: ~AUD$200k seed (2013, ~USD$145k), AUD$28M/USD$20.2M Series A (Aug 2020, TechCrunch), and USD$21M Series B (Nov 2022, company blog). Total ≈ USD$41.3-41.4M.
total_funding_usd.quote: This round is the company's first since Buildkite raised about AUD $200,000 in seed funding when it was founded in 2013.

last_round.quote: I'm excited to announce Buildkite has raised a US$21M Series B, led by Airtree & OneVentures, to continue our mission to unblock every developer on the planet.

revenue.basis: Company's own About page bio for co-founder Tim Lucas
revenue.quote: raising two rounds of funding and scaling the company to US$15M ARR and a team of 75.

note: Independent, bootstrapped-then-VC-backed Australian company (founded Perth 2013; team fully remote across 60+ cities). Was profitable/growing before taking outside money (seed ~AUD$200k in 2013, then no more funding until Series A in 2020). Series A: AUD$28M (~USD$20.2M) led by OpenView with General Catalyst participating (Aug 2020), valuing the company at >AUD$200M (~USD$145M). Series B: USD$21M led by Airtree & OneVentures (Nov 2022). ARR figure of US$15M and team of 75 are as of ~2022 (when co-founder Tim Lucas stepped back from co-CEO); no more recent revenue/employee figures were found. Current CEO is Kevin Gounden (per About page), a later leadership change from founder-CEO.
